notes.title: The Steam Summer Sale is Here... and so is the Mac Version!
notes.notes:
Time flies, and it's been 8 whole years since Kero Blaster released...
This year, we've joined the Steam Summer Sale like we always have, but this year is a little different...
Because finally, at long last, Kero Blaster is playable on the Mac!

There are probably some of you who bought Kero Blaster on a Windows PC, but switched to a Mac somewhere along the way and couldn't play the game anymore... But now you can! Why not pick it up again to celebrate the occasion?

No matter whether you're a new player or a Kero Blaster veteran, we also recommend the free games Pink Hour and Pink Heaven, where a certain pink office lady gets to be in the spotlight! Both of those games are also playable on the Mac now, so you could try out the free spinoffs first before playing Kero Blaster if you'd like!

Pink Hour (It's free!)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/409670/Pink_Hour/

Pink Heaven (Also free!)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/409690/Pink_Heaven/

And here's the special commemorative music written by sasakure.UK back when Kero Blaster released on the Switch. Give it another listen while you're here!

Kero Blaster - It's my blaster! [sasakure.UK Remix]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k3NfiIZa0dQ

Kero Blaster - Check’IN Out [sasakure.UK Remix]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHtB0EJ_ELM

notes.title: [Touhou Luna Nights]100K Downloads! Thank You for Your Support! “Dash” Fixes & German Support Incl. in Update!
notes.notes:
Dear players,
 
Touhou Luna Nights, which saw its final update roll out on June 15th, has officially topped 100,000 downloads!
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cf141467679ffe57a92fb74a8cbc8e23c14594ac.gif
 
It’s thanks to the invaluable support and reviews of players like you that we were able to pass this significant milestone less than four months after the Ver. 1.0 release on February 26th. 
Thank you all so much!
 
Below we’ve got a comment received from the developers at Team Ladybug!
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/afba758722711029623f4b8e40e44b50738e63f9.jpg
 
To be honest, we are truly surprised by all the support we’ve received from so many players out there. We are extremely happy to see how much players like the graphics and game systems we’ve worked so hard to create. From here on out, we will continue to strive to create games enjoyable by both children and adults alike, and we greatly appreciate your invaluable and ongoing support.
-Team Ladybug
 
Also, we’ve implemented fixes for the “Dash” feature that everyone requested.
 
1) Dash now ends when the lever is in neutral
2) Dash now ends and the character dodges backward when attacking and pushing the lever left or right during Dash
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/015243e64a091ff41527729fd9fa99291aec23cb.gif
 
Finally, we’ve also implemented the German language support we promised earlier.
 
There’s a brand new mode available after clearing Boss Rush, so keep playing Touhou Luna Nights and see if you can make it all the way through!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cc548ee0b2abc1bd8d0f9dfd7a2d011d245eb2ae.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/
